core_meaning.primary_meaning: Golzar is a Persian-origin name meaning “Rose garden, flower bed”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Golzar corresponds to the Persian form گلزار (Persian گلزار (golzār) 'rose garden, flower bed', from گل + زار). Its core sense is flower garden, rose garden. Golzar is the Persian گلزار (golzār) 'rose garden, flower bed' (گل 'flower' + زار 'place of'). The source gave the meaningless غزر as the 'Arabic form' and glossed it 'jewel, treasure'; both were corrected.
